Hi Marissa / Vivek —

Thanks for reaching out. Quick summary for the Singapore entry process for multinational groups: 

1) Standard tourist/business visa (for nationalities that require a visa): 4–6 weeks from Consulate submission.
2) Expedited processing available (2–3 weeks) with an additional administrative fee and courier premium.
3) We require an original signed invitation (signed by company exec) + copy of passport data page for each applicant. For sponsor-letter workflows (Acme signs sponsor letter), we still need invite wording that references the purpose, exact dates, and local host details.

Deliverables we can take from you: completed passport data CSV, signed invitation PDFs, and Acme sponsor letters. We will prepare individual visa packets and handle courier routing. Our quoted turnaround (non-expedited) assumes submission no later than Dec 1 to hit Jan 10 travel dates. If submission slides to Dec 10 or later, expedited is required to avoid risk.

Costs: See attached quote. If you want, we can provisionally hold appointment slots with the Consulate for Dec 6–10 submissions; that would cost a small deposit.

Regards,
